title: See which criteria end-to-end tests cover
statement: As a product manager, I can see which acceptance criteria of each built feature an end-to-end test covers, so I know which promises are proven in a real run and which are not.
overview: Trevor's direction: not every criterion is expected to have an end-to-end test, but the gap should be visible. The link is the existing pinned `verifies` relation from a test case to a criterion. Today, 51 of the 243 current criteria on this Saga's built features have a test case with code in `e2e/`.

acceptance_criteria.statement: On a story of a built feature, each criterion links to the catalog entries that verify it, or shows the gap.
A catalog entry links back to each criterion it verifies.
The QA section shows, per built feature, how many current criteria have a catalog entry, and lists those that do not.
Roadmap features are left out of those counts and lists.
A criterion with no end-to-end test is shown as a gap, and fails no validation, `status` or health check.
`check --covers e2e` exits 0 when every current criterion in scope has a catalog entry and 3 when one does not, and only a team that names that area sees it fail.
A link to a criterion revised since it was pinned shows as stale, and does not count as coverage.
